 Important Income Tax Due Dates in November 2026; Don’t Miss These Deadlines
 By 
 Author 
 / November 1, 2026 Income Tax Due Dates - 2026 , Income Tax Important Update 
 Taxpayers should note several important income-tax compliance deadlines during November 2026 . By 7 November 2026 , tax deducted or collected for October 2026 must be deposited with the Central Government, along with Securities Transaction Tax (STT) and Commodities Transaction Tax (CTT) collected for the month. Form 127 , relating to declarations by buyers for obtaining goods without collection of tax received during October 2026, is also due on this date.
 By 14 November 2026, Form 132 TDS certificates for tax deducted during September 2026 must be issued. The next important deadline is 15 November 2026, covering Form 131 and Form 133 quarterly TDS/TCS certificates for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Form 137 for Government TDS/TCS book-adjustment statements for October 2026, and Form 1 for client-code modifications by stock exchanges for October 2026.
 By 21 November 2026, the return of income for Assessment Year 2026-27 is due for corporate assessees, audited non-corporate assessees and specified partners not having any international or specified domestic transaction, together with the related forms, reports, certificates and applications linked to this return-filing deadline, including Forms 3CEFB, 3CEJA, 3CFA, 3CLA, 3CT, 5C, 10BBC, 10BBD, 10BC, 10CCD, 10CCE, 10CCF, 10E, 10-EE, 10FC, 10H, 10IA, 10-IB to 10-IK, 56FF and 62.
 The most significant compliance date is 30 November 2026 , which covers the return of income for Assessment Year 2026-27 for assessees required to furnish a report under section 92E in respect of international or specified domestic transactions, along with Form 3CEAA, Form 3CEFA, Form 3CEF, Form 49C, Form 64, Form 141 challan-cum-statements for specified tax deductions made during October 2026, and several other prescribed statements, reports, certificates and applications linked to this return-filing deadline. Self-assessment tax is also payable where the due date for filing the return of income is 30 November 2026 . Timely compliance is important to avoid applicable interest, late fees, penalties and other statutory consequences .
